audit.scope: Independent saved-record, action-applicability, artifact-content, native-source, ordering and protection audit; no repeated original operations.

boundaries: Three engineered work-world histories and format replications of one ordering-policy mechanism; not 36 independent experiences.
The tasks and aliases are designed fixtures. AI choices, subprocesses, files, validators and source returns were actually collected; no private or fictional conversation was used.
Actual AI authors and separate AI reviewers selected finite literal features from original tool output and AI judgments. This is not automatic general semantic understanding.
Only object/place aliases seed recall. Profile tokens are checked after retrieval. Shared-feature support paths are associative links, not causal evidence.
A newly indexed judgment being returned is distinct from its incremental benefit over indexed original evidence; ties are retained.
Each phase freezes all 12 actions before execution; one action per assignment, no retries or between-probe feedback learning.
The isolated native component bridge does not execute full canonical Wake or write production private memory. Emotion, natural conversation, biological brains, AGI and consciousness were not tested.
Shared-filesystem read allowlists are instructions, not OS-enforced isolation or provider attestation. Provider/model/settings/token/compute metadata are unavailable and null.
Returned JSON bytes and characters describe instrumented data only; no comparative SHIORI speed, equal compute, token or cost benefit is claimed.

One feature author printed the full API contract after its action/judgment were fixed; one reviewer printed the full actor contract. These read-scope deviations were preserved. No future task/gold or other-world data exposure was reported.

Four no-history abstentions cite the actual unavailability notice rather than an eligible original tool observation or native judgment. Their eligible original-source checks remain false; notification-text exactness and the appropriateness of abstention are audited separately.

The 32 rows passing eligible original-source checks include five empty-evidence rows. Twenty-seven rows contain 64 verbatim eligible tool quotations. No probe quotes a native judgment; new-judgment return is availability, not demonstrated adoption or incremental benefit. Raw obs-* source IDs map to tool:obs-* without changing any original action.

The downloadable public evidence permits arithmetic, quotation and graph-path checks only. Private native code/state are excluded; fresh AI regeneration and complete native execution replay are unavailable.
boundary: Arithmetic and exact quotation checks only; independent applicability/artifact/protection audit is separate.

judgment.why_keep: 今回の契約に明示された beta の選択、事前の accepted 予測、保存済みの受理結果と検証項目が対応している。旧 gamma 判断との差を具体的な契約条件に結び付け、適用範囲と未検証事項を限定した実行記録として保持する価値がある。
